title: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 More Words to Use Instead of "Very" (Part 2)
description:
Stop saying "very" in English: 30 more words to use instead of "very". In Part 2 you'll learn better words for very sad, very angry, very beautiful, very scared, very important and very interesting. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:16 Stop saying "very sad"
1:27 Speaking practice: very sad
2:04 Stop saying "very angry"
3:16 Speaking practice: very angry
3:54 Stop saying "very beautiful"
4:59 Speaking practice: very beautiful
5:38 Stop saying "very scared"
6:45 Speaking practice: very scared
7:21 Stop saying "very important"
8:30 Speaking practice: very important
9:02 Stop saying "very interesting"
10:17 Speaking practice: very interesting

The 30 words
Very sad: miserable, heartbroken, devastated, gloomy, down in the dumps
Very angry: furious, livid, outraged, fuming, irate
Very beautiful: gorgeous, stunning, breathtaking, exquisite, radiant
Very scared: terrified, petrified, horrified, panic-stricken, scared stiff
Very important: crucial, essential, vital, critical, paramount
Very interesting: fascinating, captivating, gripping, intriguing, absorbing

Which word was new to you? Write it in the comments.
